hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Five-Star Business Finance as an NBFC providing secured, property-backed small-ticket loans to small business owners and self-employed individuals with informal incomes who are largely cut off from the formal lending ecosystem, underwritten through a proprietary, fully in-house, ground-verification model built over two decades.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- "NBFC providing secured financial solutions to Small Business customers and Self-employed Individuals who are largely cut-off from formal lending ecosystem"; average ticket size of Rs 3-5 lakhs and household gross income of Rs 25,000-40,000.
- All loans are secured against borrower property, "usually self occupied residential property", with the mortgage registered at the Sub-registrar office, which the deck says helps avoid multiple loans against the same property.
- Proprietary underwriting and collections model "fine-tuned over 2 decades"; surrogates (lifestyle, ownership of assets, trade checks) are used to evaluate borrower cashflows in the absence of verifiable income documents, with approval powers held only by the Credit team and none with the Business team.
- Rating journey shown from BB+ (2012) to AA- (2023); current Long Term Credit Rating ICRA AA- Stable, CARE AA- Positive, India Ratings AA- Positive, and Short Term CARE A1+.
- Governance claim: "Clean Track Record | No Auditor Qualifications | Multiple RBI Inspections with NIL divergences | Fully automated Compliance tracking"; statutory audit by Deloitte Haskins & Sells, external internal audit by Sundaram & Srinivasan.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- CRAR of 51.89% in FY2026 (50.10% FY2025); Debt/Equity of 1.03 and Leverage (Total assets / Net worth) of 2.07 in Q1FY2027.
- Liquidity buffer as of June 2026 stated as unencumbered cash & cash equivalents of 18,472 Mn plus unavailed sanction from banks / FIs of 4,500 Mn, with Total Liquidity stated at 22,972 Mn.
- ALM statement: "No Cumulative mismatch in any of the time buckets", with a projected closing liquidity of 25,554 Mn by Q1FY28.
- Liability mix spans Bank Term Loans, TL from Indian DFIs / Others, NCD, Securitisation and ECB, with lenders including SBI, Bank of Baroda, Kotak, IndusInd, DBS, IFC, ADB, Swedfund, NABARD and SIDBI.
- Deck notes "All Management team members hold shares / options amounting to ~2% of the Company's capital" on a fully diluted basis, and describes a well-diversified cap table with strong FII and mutual fund participation.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Board change] Anand Raghavan, Independent Director and Chair of the Audit Committee, "Will cease to be a Director upon completion of 10-year term w.e.f July 27, 2026"; Sreeram Iyer was "Appointed as Additional Director w.e.f July 25, 2026".
- [Asset quality trend] Gross NPA at 3.46% in Q1FY27 (3.37% in Q4FY26) and Net NPA at 2.10% (2.00%), with slippage ratio flat at 0.70% and credit cost to average AUM easing to 1.85% from 1.88%; Provision Coverage Ratio on GNPA at 40.14% vs 41.40%.
- [Definition conflict] The Financial Highlights slide defines "Net interest income = Total Income less Interest expenses", while the Glossary defines Net Interest Income as "interest income on term loans minus Interest on borrowings, Interest on debt securities and other interest expense" — two different definitions in the same deck.
- [Technology] GenAI is being deployed operationally — intelligent document processing, AI voice bots in local languages for automated collections, and voice-to-data conversion — alongside proprietary ML credit risk scoring and partner-assisted bounce prediction analytics.
